questions.name: Payroll
questions.text: QuickBooks Online Payroll is available as an add-on to any QBO subscription and comes in multiple service tiers offering different levels of automation and HR support. A business owner asks their bookkeeper how many payroll tier options are available. How many QBO Payroll subscription tiers does the Student Guide identify?

answers.text: Three tiers: Core, Premium, and Elite
Four tiers: Core, Standard, Premium, and Elite
Two tiers: Basic and Premium
Five tiers: Starter, Core, Standard, Premium, and Elite

explanations.a: The Student Guide identifies three QBO Payroll subscription tiers: Core, Premium, and Elite.
explanations.b: Four tiers is incorrect; there is no Standard payroll tier. The three tiers are Core, Premium, and Elite.
explanations.c: Two tiers is incorrect; the Student Guide identifies three QBO Payroll tiers: Core, Premium, and Elite.
explanations.d: Five tiers is incorrect; the Student Guide lists only three payroll tiers: Core, Premium, and Elite.

questions.name: Payroll
questions.text: A payroll administrator needs to process the company's bi-weekly payroll in QuickBooks Online. They need to navigate to the correct area of QBO to start the payroll run. Which navigation path correctly leads to the Run Payroll function in QBO?

answers.text: Gear icon → Your Company → Manage Users → Run Payroll
Workers tab → Employees sub-tab → Run Payroll button
Reports tab → Employees group → Run Payroll
+New → Employees group → Payroll Run

explanations.a: The gear icon's Manage Users section handles user accounts, not payroll processing.
explanations.b: The Student Guide states that payroll is run by clicking Workers in the left navigation bar, selecting the Employees sub-tab, and clicking the Run Payroll button.
explanations.c: The Reports tab opens the Report Center; payroll processing is not initiated from there.
explanations.d: The +New menu contains transaction types; Run Payroll is not listed as a +New option.

questions.name: Payroll
questions.text: After running payroll, a payroll administrator wants to view a high-level summary showing total wages, taxes withheld, and net pay for each employee for the pay period. They navigate to the payroll reports section. Which payroll report provides a summary of total wages and deductions for each employee for a selected period?

answers.text: Payroll Tax Liability
Employee Contact List report
Payroll Summary by Employee report
Payroll Detail by Employee

explanations.a: The Payroll Tax Liability shows amounts owed to tax agencies, not a per-employee wage and deduction summary.
explanations.b: The Employee Contact List is a roster report, not a payroll calculation summary.
explanations.c: The Student Guide identifies the Payroll Summary by Employee report as the report showing total wages, deductions, and net pay per employee for a selected period.
explanations.d: The Payroll Detail by Employee shows transaction-level payroll detail; the Payroll Summary provides the high-level totals per employee.

questions.name: Payroll
questions.text: Before remitting quarterly payroll taxes to the IRS and state agencies, a controller wants to run a report in QBO that shows all payroll tax amounts owed by tax type and agency. They look through the payroll reports available. Which payroll report shows the taxes the company owes to tax agencies?

answers.text: Payroll Summary report
Employees list report
Payroll Detail by Employee report
Payroll Tax Liability report

explanations.a: The Payroll Summary report shows per-employee wage totals; it does not break down tax obligations by agency.
explanations.b: The Employees list is a roster, not a payroll tax obligation report.
explanations.c: The Payroll Detail by Employee report shows individual paycheck-level detail, not agency-level tax liabilities.
explanations.d: The Student Guide identifies the Payroll Tax Liability report as the report that shows the company's payroll tax obligations to tax agencies.

questions.name: Payroll
questions.text: After entering hours and earnings for all employees in the QBO payroll run screen, the payroll administrator is ready to finalize the payroll. The Student Guide describes a two-step final action that must be taken to complete the payroll cycle before paychecks are created. What are the final two steps to complete a payroll run in QBO after entering employee hours and pay amounts?

answers.text: Save for later, then Approve and print checks
Preview Payroll, then Submit Payroll
Calculate taxes, then Confirm and deposit to bank
Review deductions, then Email employees their pay stubs

explanations.a: Save for later is used to pause a payroll run in progress; Approve and print is not the described final step sequence.
explanations.b: The Student Guide states that after entering hours the user clicks Preview Payroll to review, then clicks Submit Payroll to finalize the pay run.
explanations.c: Calculate taxes is performed automatically by QBO; the final user actions are Preview Payroll and Submit Payroll.
explanations.d: Emailing pay stubs may occur after submission but is not the final step sequence described in the Student Guide for completing a payroll run.

questions.name: Payroll
questions.text: During a payroll run preview in QBO, a payroll administrator notices that one employee's hours were entered incorrectly. Before clicking Submit Payroll, the administrator wants to correct the hours on that single check without discarding the entire payroll run. What does the Student Guide describe as the way to edit an individual check during a payroll run?

answers.text: Cancel the entire payroll run, correct the timesheet, and restart payroll from the beginning
Submit the payroll as-is, then create a correcting paycheck in the next pay period
Click the pencil/edit icon next to the employee's check to open and modify it before submitting
Use the Void check feature in the Banking Center after payroll is submitted to remove the incorrect check

explanations.a: Restarting the entire payroll run is unnecessary; QBO allows editing individual checks within the preview screen using the edit icon.
explanations.b: Deferring a correction to the next period creates compliance issues and extra work; the guide describes an in-run edit method.
explanations.c: The Student Guide states that during a payroll run, clicking the pencil or edit icon next to an employee's check opens it for correction before final submission.
explanations.d: Voiding is a post-submission action; the Student Guide describes using the edit icon during the preview stage, before Submit Payroll is clicked.
